type A<X> = X extends { a: number } ? X["a"] : never;
type Pair<X extends { b: string }> = X extends { a: number } ? [X["a"], X["b"]] : never;
type Length<X> = X extends string ? X["length"] : never;
type Inferred<X> = X extends { a: infer A } ? X["a"] : never;
type Nested<X> = X extends { a: number } ? (X extends { b: string } ? [X["a"], X["b"]] : X["a"]) : never;
type Head<X> = X extends [infer H, ...unknown[]] ? X[0] : never;
type Size<X> = X extends readonly unknown[] ? X["length"] : never;
type Wrapped<X> = [X] extends [{ a: number }] ? X["a"] : never;
type Kept<X extends { a: number }> = X extends unknown ? X["a"] : never;
const a: A<{ a: number }> = 42;
const pair: Pair<{ a: number; b: string }> = [1, "s"];
const textLength: Length<"abc"> = 3;
const inferred: Inferred<{ a: boolean }> = true;
const nested: Nested<{ a: 5 }> = 5;
const head: Head<[1, 2]> = 1;
const size: Size<[1, 2, 3]> = 3;
const wrapped: Wrapped<{ a: 7 }> = 7;
const kept: Kept<{ a: 9 }> = 9;
console.log(a, pair, textLength, inferred, nested, head, size, wrapped, kept);
